column2: (2) In the exercise of its powers under subsection (1) the

column1: Central Bank shall be guided by best international standards.
The payment system policy of the Central Bank shall primarily
be designed to facilitate the overall stability of the financial
system, promote payment system safety and efficiency and
control  risk.  Subject  to  this  primary  objective,  the  policy
shall  be  designed  to  enhance  other  aspects  of  the  public
interest  and  particularly  contribute  to  the  promotion  of
competition  in  the  market  for  payment  services  and  the
protection of payment system users.

column2: (3)  In  promoting  safety  and  efficiency  of  the  payment

column1: system the Central Bank shall co-operate with Central Banks
of other countries and with other relevant domestic or foreign
authorities.

column2: (1)  The  Central  Bank  shall  maintain  securities

column1: accounts for each direct participant and for each customer of
a dealer direct participant. A person may have more than one
securities account. A securities account may be a designated
securities account.

column2: (2) A securities account holder may exercise all the rights

column1: that  comprise  the  security  credited  to  his  or  her  securities
account,  or  designated  securities  account,  subject  to  any
applicable adverse claim :

column2: Provided however, a customer securities account holder

column1: may deal with his or her securities account as provided in
this section only through a dealer direct participant authorized
to act in that customer’s securities account :

column2: Provided further that, no remedy against the account holder

column1: will  be  prejudiced  where  the  exercise  of  rights  under  this
section is in breach of a contract or is otherwise in violation
of the rights of any other person.
